title: add RAG templates, tool-calling agent samples, and quickstart docs
author: Priya Anand
release_notes: Added RAG quickstarts and agent tool-calling examples: - New RAG templates for customer support and product search - Tool-calling agent example (OpenWeather) and README - Site quickstarts index and config tweaks for sidebar and TOC
description:
Summary: Adds first-pass RAG quickstarts and tool-calling agent examples to the docs and examples repos. This PR introduces opinionated RAG templates, an agent example that demonstrates tool calling (weather lookup), and quickstart pages that walk engineers through getting started with RAG and tool-calling on Redwood.

Motivation: We have growing demand from developer users for end-to-end RAG quickstarts and concrete agent/tool-calling examples that work with our SDKs. These docs will reduce onboarding friction and provide canonical templates for common patterns (customer support, product search, enrichment pipelines).

What I changed: - docs/quickstarts/rag/customer-support.md: new quickstart with step-by-step setup, prompts, and evaluation tips. - docs/quickstarts/rag/product-search.md: RAG pattern tailored for search + reranking with notes on index refresh and chunking. - examples/agents/tool_calling/README.md: agent architecture, expected inputs/outputs, deployment notes. - examples/agents/tool_calling/open_weather_tool.py: small tool example and agent harness demonstrating function/tool calling + streaming responses. - examples/templates/rag/template_support.json: opinionated RAG template (index config, chunk size, prompt scaffold). - site/content/docs/quickstarts/_index.md and site/config.yaml: add entries for new quickstarts so they appear in the sidebar and search. - scripts/ci/validate-docs.sh: CI helper to ensure frontmatter and links are valid.

Testing and QA: - Local site build and preview (hugo) tested; verified new pages render and sidebar order is correct. - Ran docs link-checker and our new validate-docs.sh in CI. - Example agent run verified against a mocked OpenWeather response and local vector index using small dataset. CI: docs-build: pass, lint: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-tests: pass, site-preview: pass.

Notes for reviewers: - I kept the code/examples intentionally small and self-contained; production users should swap the mock tool for a network-backed client and wire KMS/credentials as needed. - The RAG templates include recommended tokenization and chunk sizes for the models in our catalog (see inline comments). If we change the default models (ENG-4821), the prompt scaffolds may need minor edits.

Follow-ups: - Add a second agent example showing multi-tool orchestration (ENG-4821 follow-up). - Create a quick eval harness for the support quickstart to detect quality regressions on model upgrades.

Checklist: - [x] Quickstarts added - [x] Examples and README added - [x] Site config updated - [x] CI checks updated and passing

Links: Linear ENG-4821, PM-1290; preview: https://deploy-preview/redwood-docs/67690

review_comments: Marcus Lee (review): Please add explicit examples for chunk size calculations when using long contexts; also suggested a short note on cost tradeoffs. — Author: added a small section and example calculations.
Sofia Grant (review): Nit: make the README commands OS-agnostic and add a note about Python 3.11. — Author: updated README to use python -m and call out supported runtimes.
Diego Rivera (approval): Verified site build and example run locally; approved with minor doc wording suggestions.
notes: This is a docs-first PR; examples are intentionally minimal to keep maintenance cost low.
If we want to promote the OpenWeather agent as a canonical sample, we should add a small e2e test in perf-canary to ensure streaming stability.
